methodology: Two standalone pure Motoko controls on the prepared SDK; independent input bytes match the indicated native groups, public byte parsing and validation remain timed. No historical results are reused.

cases.name: pure-secp256k1-verify-ecdsa-rfc6979-key1-sample
cases.notes: Valid input only. Curve construction and immutable inputs are outside timing; compressed-key and compact-signature parsing, validation, verification and public result handling remain inside. Timed Result unwrap and static oracle Blob selection match the native Secp256k1 direct case. The Secp256k1 signature is low-S. General malformed-input semantics are not compared.
adapter_changes: Key, digest and signature literals replaced with the independent prepared fixture.
Timed Result unwrap and static oracle Blob selection match the native Secp256k1 direct case.

cases.name: pure-p256-verify-rfc-sample
cases.notes: Valid input only. Curve construction and immutable inputs are outside timing; compressed-key and compact-signature parsing, validation, verification and public result handling remain inside. One-iteration measured loop and retained Result match the native P256 direct case. P256 high-S input is normalized internally by ecdsa Signature; this is not a general error/canonicality equivalence claim.
adapter_changes: Key, digest and signature literals replaced with the independent prepared fixture.
One-iteration measured loop and retained Result match the native P256 direct case.
